description: Use when you need to vet a counterparty before paying or onboarding it: one call screens a name (and an optional wallet address) against OFAC SDN, UK, EU, Canada and US CSL. Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /check/counterparty, $0.015 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Sanctions part: UK and Canada: organisations and wallets only. A name, optionally with country, LEI or wallet address; for one payee address before paying use check_payee; for a plain list lookup of an address or name use sanctions_screening. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

address.description: Optional crypto wallet address to screen too

country.description: Optional ISO country, e.g. DE (non-US skips the FDIC section)

lei.description: Optional 20-character LEI: read instead of a name search

name: check_counterparty
title: Check counterparty
